qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect give this card +1000 DP when it has a red 2-color card as a digivolution card?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't.
A red 2-color card isn't considered a "non-red card."

changes.before: [Your Turn]When an effect suspends a Digimon, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.
changes.after: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an effect suspends a Digimon, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate when an effect suspends one of my Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate even when this card is trashed from digivolution cards by my own effect and not my opponent's?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Is it true that both the Digimon card and the Tamer card must have the [Xros Heart] trait in order for this card's effect to be able to add them to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card or a Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait or a Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If both Digimon and Tamer cards with the [Xros Heart] trait are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card and 1 Tamer card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: Can I choose not to activate this card’s [End of Attack] effect by not performing "placing all digivolution cards from under this Digimon under 1 of your Tamers", thus preventing this Digimon from being deleted?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect if this Digimon doesn't have any digivolution cards?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't activate unless you can perform "placing all digivolution cards from under this Digimon under 1 of your Tamers."

qa.question: If I activate this card's [End of Attack] effect, can I unsuspend a different Tamer than the Tamer under which I placed the digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If more than 1 of my Tamers suspend at the same time, does this card's "+2000 DP" effect activate multiple times?
qa.answer: No, even if multiple Tamers suspend at the same time, this effect will only give +2000 DP.

qa.question: I digivolve a Digimon with [Gammamon] in its name and a [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect into this card. Can I activate the [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect through this card's [All Turns] effect and attack?
qa.answer: Yes, if the memory gauge is now at 1 or greater on your opponent's side, you can activate <Blitz>.

qa.question: I digivolve a [BT8-013 BetelGammamon] into a [BT8-084 Kimeramon] and place this card as one of [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s digivolution cards with its [When Digivolving] effect. Can I now activate [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s [When Digivolving] <Blitz> effect through this card's inherited effect and attack?
qa.answer: No, you can't. If this card is added to digivolution cards by [BT8-084 Kimeramon]'s [When Digivolving] effect, you get [BT8-013 BetelGammamon]'s <Blitz> effect through this card, but the time to trigger <Blitz> has already passed, so <Blitz> doesn't activate.

qa.question: If I have multiple digivolution cards with [Gammamon] in their names, does this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect give me all of their effects?
qa.answer: Yes, you gain all the effects from every applicable card, even if there are multiple of them.

qa.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect allow me to activate the inherited effect of a digivolution card with [Gammamon] in its name as an effect of this card?
qa.answer: No, this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect don't affect the inherited effects of digivolution cards with [Gammamon] in their names.

qa.question: Due to an effect, this Digimon has another [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and a [BT8-008 Gammamon] under it as its digivolution cards. If I play a red Tamer, how exactly does [BT8-008 Gammamon]'s "When you play a red Tamer, <Draw 1> (Draw 1 card from your deck)" effect work in this situation?
qa.answer: This card's effect and inherited effect mean that this Digimon gains [BT8-008 Gammamon]'s effects twice, so <Draw 1> is activated twice and you draw a total of 2 cards.

qa.question: When a [Dobermon] with [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and [Gammamon] with an [On Play] effect in its digivolution cards digivolves into this card, does this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate the [On Play] effect on both this card and the [Gammamon] digivolution card?
qa.answer: Yes, they activate.

qa.question: When a [Cerberusmon] with [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and [Gammamon] with an [On Play] effect in its digivolution cards digivolves into this card, does this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate the [On Play] effect on both this card and the [Gammamon] digivolution card?
qa.answer: Yes, they activate.

qa.question: When this Digimon digivolves into BT10-011 [Canoweissmon], I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect after gaining it using BT10-011 [Canoweissmon]'s [All Turns] effect, and I place a card with a [When Digivolving] effect and [Gammamon] in its name from my hand in that Digimon's digivolution cards. Can I activate the placed card's [When Digivolving] effect at such times?
qa.answer: No, you can't activate it.

qa.question: Can I use <Material Save> on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Shoutmon] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card is only treated as [Shoutmon] for a DigiXros.

qa.question: Can I use <Material Save> on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Starmons] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card is only treated as [Starmons] for a DigiXros.

qa.question: Can I use <Material Save> on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Dorulumon] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card is only treated as [Dorulumon] for a DigiXros.

qa.question: Can I use <Material Save> on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Ballistamon] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card is only treated as [Ballistamon] for a DigiXros.

qa.question: I have a [Jesmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, and one of my Digimon has [Sistermon] in its name. Do my Digimon get +4000 DP from this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: No, they only get +2000 DP from this effect.

qa.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reads "all of your Digimon may also attack unsuspended Digimon and get +2000 DP." Does this also affect my Digimon that enter the battle area in the same turn after I've digivolved into this card?
qa.answer: Yes, it does. However, Digimon affected by this effect still can't ignore the rule "Digimon can't attack on the turn that they were played".

qa.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack. When does [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect activate?
qa.answer:
Since both the [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] having been played and this Digimon attacking with <Blitz> happened during this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect, the Digimon being played and the attack are treated as having happened at the same time for the purpose of triggering effects.
The turn player can choose the order in which to activate the [On Play] effect and any potential [When Attacking] and such effects.

qa.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack, and when the [When Attacking] effect deleted one of my opponent's Digimon, my [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was deleted by the [On Deletion] effect of the opponent's Digimon. [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect hasn't activated yet, so does it activate?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't activate.
The [On Play] effect from [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was triggered, but it cannot activate because the [Sistermon Blanc] is deleted before it is able to activate.

qa.question: What does a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer:
Such effects prevent your opponent from playing XX by effects.
With this card's effect, your opponent can no longer play Digimon by effects such as BT10-018 [Gaossmon]'s [On Deletion] effect or BT16-048 [TyrantKabuterimon]'s [When Digivolving] effect.
This effect affects the opponent player.

qa.question: What does a "your opponent can't play XX by effects" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer:
Such effects prevent your opponent from playing XX by effects.
With this card's effect, your opponent can no longer play Digimon or Tamers by effects such as BT10-018 [Gaossmon]'s [On Deletion] effect or BT9-099 [Sunrise Buster]'s [Main] effect.
This effect affects the opponent player.

qa.question: If I have a [Kiriha Aonuma] in play, do I get to choose either "Reveal 4 cards from the top of your deck. Add 2 cards with [Blue Flare] in their traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order" or "return 1 [MetalGreymon] from your trash to your hand" for this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can choose one or the other.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to add a card to my hand when only 1 card with the [Blue Flare] trait is among the 4 revealed cards?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: In order to <Draw 2> from this card's [When Digivolving] effect, do I need to have 6 or fewer cards in my hand after drawing the digivolution bonus card?
qa.answer: Yes, that's right. <Draw 2> does not activate if you have 7 or more cards in your hand after drawing the digivolution bonus.

qa.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect target the opponent's Digimon that don't have digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: An opponent's Digimon was targeted by this card's [On Play] effect, and after that it gained more digivolution cards than this Digimon has, can it now attack and block again?
qa.answer: No. As long as the number of digivolution cards that Digimon had was less than or equal to this Digimon's at the time this effect was activated, this effect stays and it can't attack or block?even if it later gains more digivolution cards.

qa.question: If this Digimon has both level 3 and level 4 Digimon cards in its digivolution cards, can I choose to play just 1 of them with this card's [When Attacking] effect?
qa.answer: No. If you choose to play cards with the [When Attacking] effect, you must play as many cards as possible?so if cards of both levels are in the digivolution cards, you can't play just 1 of them.

qa.question: An opponent's Digimon is targeted by this card's [On Play] effect. If it later becomes level 6 or above, does it lose the <Security Attack -1> gained from this effect?
qa.answer: No. As long as it was level 5 or lower when this effect was activated, the effect remains and it still has <Security Attack -1>?even if it later becomes level 6 or higher.

qa.question: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: 1 Option card with [Plug-In] in its name and 1 yellow Tamer card.

qa.question: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?
qa.answer: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.

qa.question: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or <Delay>, the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.

qa.question: An Option card's use cost is 1 or less when used from the hand due to an effect such as BT2-099 [Glorious Burst] or BT8-097 [Crimson Blaze]'s 1st effect. When such a card is used, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't trigger.
If a card's cost itself is reduced when it's used from the hand, it's considered to be using an Option card with a use cost after the reduction is applied. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect doesn't trigger.

qa.question: An Option card has an original use cost of 2 or more, and I use it when the cost to pay is reduced to 1 or less. At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
qa.answer:
Yes, it triggers.
If the card's cost to pay is reduced and not the use cost itself, it's considered to be using an Option card with its original value as its use cost. Therefore, the "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect triggers.

qa.question: I used an effect to use an Option card with an original use cost of 2 or more without paying the cost. At such times, does this card's "when you use an Option card with a use cost of 2 or more" effect trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, it triggers.

qa.question: While this card is in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with [Shoutmon] in its name, do my opponent's Security Digimon get -2000 DP from this card's inherited effect even when they are checked by some other Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, they get -2000 DP even when checked by some other Digimon than the one that has this in its digivolution cards.

qa.question: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -5000 DP for the turn" effect and the "gain 2 memory" effect when activating this card's [When Attacking] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you do.

qa.question: It's currently my turn after the turn when my opponent activated BT9-103 [Kongou]'s effect. If I activate this card's [When Digivolving] effect and use an Option card, can I place that Option card on top of the security stack instead of placing it in the trash?
qa.answer:
No, you can't place it in the trash.
BT9-103 [Kongou]'s effect prevents cards from being added to your security stack, so the used Option card is trashed.

qa.question: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use P-037 [Yellow Memory Boost!], and I use P-037 [Yellow Memory Boost!]'s 1st [Main] effect to place that card in the battle area. What happens to "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect at such times?
qa.answer: P-037 [Yellow Memory Boost!] can't be placed in the trash, therefore it can't be placed on top of the security stack.

qa.question: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use BT4-105 [Tactical Retreat!], then I placed this card itself on top of the security stack. At such times, after using BT4-105 [Tactical Retreat!], will it be placed in the security stack by the "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" effect?
qa.answer: Yes, it will be placed in the security stack.

qa.question: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to use ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V], and ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V]'s [Main] effect linked that card to a Digimon. What happens to "place the Option card used with this effect on top of your security stack face down instead of placing it in your trash" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect at such times?
qa.answer: ST22-08 [Offensive Plug-In V] can't be placed in the trash, therefore it can't be placed on top of the security stack.

qa.question: Does "can't attack this Digimon and can't activate [When Attacking] and [When Digivolving] effects" in this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect apply to opponent's Digimon with <Security Attack +X> as well as those with <Security Attack -X>?
qa.answer: Yes, all of your opponent's Digimon with either <Security Attack +X> or <Security Attack -X> are affected by "can't attack this Digimon and can't activate [When Attacking] and [When Digivolving] effects."

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play, and I digivolve one of my Digimon into a Digimon card that has <Security Attack +1> and a [When Digivolving] effect. Does that Digimon activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: No, it has <Security Attack +1> as soon as the digivolution is complete, so this card's effect prevents the [When Digivolving] effect from activating.

qa.question: What kind of Digimon does this effect's "Digimon with <Security Attack>" refer to?
qa.answer: It refers to Digimon affected by <Security Attack +> or <Security Attack -> effects.

qa.question: If an opponent's Digimon has both <Security Attack +1> and <Security Attack -1> so the values cancel each other out, is the Digimon treated as not having <Security Attack>, and is it unaffected by "Digimon with <Security Attack> can't attack this Digimon and can't activate [When Attacking] and [When Digivolving] effects"?
qa.answer:
No, <Security Attack> is not canceled even if a Digimon has both <Security Attack +1> and <Security Attack -1>.
The Digimon is considered to have <Security Attack>, so the effect applies to this Digimon.

qa.question: I digivolved one of my [MetalGreymon] into [BT9-015 MetalGreymon (X Antibody)]. It gets <Security Attack+1> and +3000 DP with its [When Digivolving] effect, but does that effect activate when my opponent has this Digimon in play?
qa.answer: Yes, it activates. [BT9-015 MetalGreymon (X Antibody)] gains <Security Attack +1> from the [When Digivolving] effect, so after that effect has activated, this card then prevents further [When Attacking] and [When Digivolving] effects from activating.

qa.question: If a Digimon has a <Security Attack> effect that is only active when certain conditions are met, such as "While this Digimon has X or more digivolution cards, it gains <Security Attack +1>," does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect apply when these conditions aren't met?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. One of my Digimon that doesn't have <Security Attack> attacks it, and then the attacking Digimon gains <Security Attack> from a [When Attacking] effect or an effect such as "when one of your Digimon attacks". What happens to the attack?
qa.answer:
The attack continues.
This effect doesn't end or cancel an attack if the attacking Digimon gains <Security Attack> after the attack has been declared. It prevents Digimon with <Security Attack> from declaring the attack.

qa.question: When a Digimon with <Security Attack> attacks, does this card's effect stop "when this Digimon attacks" effects of those Digimon, such as <Raid>?
qa.answer: No, "When... attacks" effects are not [When Attacking] effects, so this card's effect can't stop them from activating.

qa.question: I have a [Jesmon GX] that has <Security Attack> in play, while my opponent has a [BT10-042 Venusmon] in play. If I use this card and target my [Jesmon GX], can this card's effect activate [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] effects?
qa.answer: No. Because [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] and [When Attacking] effects cannot be activated due to your opponent's [BT10-042 Venusmon], even this card can't activate those effects in these circumstances.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to digivolve this card into a [Venusmon] such as BT10-042 [Venusmon] that doesn't meet the digivolution requirements, ignoring level?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
Digivolution while ignoring level is only possible as long as the digivolution requirements are met.

qa.question: Can this card's effect add cards that have the trait [Ancient Plant] or [Carnivorous Plant], etc.?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include 1 card with [Vegetation] or [Plant] in one of its traits or with the [Fairy] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as at least 1 card with [Vegetation] or [Plant] in one of its traits or with the [Fairy] trait is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If both a card with [Vegetation] or [Plant] in one of its traits and a card with [Fairy] in one of its traits are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the other at the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect does not feature language that would make it optional, so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: I digivolve this card into a card that has <Digisorption> in my hand, and suspend 1 of my Digimon with the <Digisorption> effect. Can I activate this card's inherited effect and <Draw 1>?
qa.answer: No, you can't. The Digimon is suspended by <Digisorption> before the digivolution is complete, so the inherited effect cannot be triggered yet.

qa.question: If this Digimon is suspended, can it itself become the target when its [Opponent's Turn] effect switches the target of an opponent's Digimon's attack?
qa.answer: Yes, you can choose to do so.

qa.question: When one of my opponent's Digimon attacks, in what order do that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect and this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
qa.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their [When Attacking] effect first.

qa.question: Can I suspend this card itself to activate this card's [Main] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Does this card's inherited effect activate if 1 of my Digimon attacks with <Blitz> and I suspend it?
qa.answer: No, suspending to declare an attack is not the same as being suspended by an effect even when attacking via <Blitz>, so the inherited effect does not activate.

qa.question: If this Digimon and one of my other Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of its traits are deleted at the same time during the opponent's turn, does the [On Deletion] effect gained from this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: If I have a suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of its traits, can I choose to suspend this Digimon itself with this card's [When Digivolving], gain 2 memory, then unsuspend this Digimon and gain <Piercing>?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If I have 4 suspended Digimon, does this Digimon gain +4000 DP and <Security Attack +1> twice?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: Does this card itself count as a suspended Digimon for this card's [Your Turn] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, this Digimon counts if it's suspended.

qa.question: What happens to the cards that weren't added to my hand from among the cards revealed by this card’s effects?
qa.answer: You place them at the bottom of your deck in any order. Please see the notices regarding changes to the rules/rulings on the official website.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include 1 card that is either black with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in its name or 1 card with the [Twilight] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If 2 cards that are either black with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in their names and/or the [Twilight] trait are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer:
No. This card's effect reads “Add 2 cards [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
However, if you have a black card with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in its name and the [Twilight] trait among the revealed cards and there are no other cards with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in their names, you can treat that card as your card with the [Twilight] trait and add it to your hand. Any other cards that have the [Twilight] trait will then be returned to the bottom of your deck. In such a case, it can be possible to add just 1 of the cards.

qa.question: If my opponent does not have any Digimon in play so there is no target for <De-Digivolve 1>, can I still place this card under 1 of my Digimon that has the [Legend-Arms] or [Xros Heart] trait when activating this card's [On Play] effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I play this card while DigiXrosing with 2 cards, but there are no cards with [Knightmon] in their name, [DeadlyAxemon], or [Nene Amano] among the cards revealed by the [On Play] effect. Does the "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 4 or less" effect still activate?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon].")
qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] names.

qa.question: When this Digimon would be deleted, if neither [SkullKnightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, can I still return 1 level 4 or lower black Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to my hand when activating this card's [All Turns]?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Is digivolution using BT10-067 [Justimon: Critical Arm]'s [When Attacking] effect possible while a "players can't ignore digivolution requirements" effect is activated?
qa.answer: No, such digivolution isn't possible.

qa.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reads "all of your Digimon get +2000 DP and your opponent's effects can't return them to hands or decks or reduce their DP." If one of my Digimon's DP is reduced before this effect activates, what happens to that Digimon's DP?
qa.answer: Its original DP is restored by "can't [...] reduce their DP," and it additionally gets +2000 DP from this effect.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect to play [BT5-111 Omnimon X Anti-body], [BT10-068 Gankoomon (X Antibody)], and [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)] from the digivolution cards of my Digimon in the breeding area?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: If [DarkKnightmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards but I can't delete a Tamer because neither I nor my opponent have any, does this card's [When Digivolving] effect unsuspend this Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, it still unsuspends.

qa.question: If [DarkKnightmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards but only I have a Tamer, can I choose to not delete my Tamer with this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer: No, you can't.

qa.question: When one of my opponent's Digimon attacks, in what order do that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect and this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
qa.answer: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their [When Attacking] effect first.

qa.question: If this Digimon has 4 or more digivolution cards when I play this card, does <Blitz> activate?
qa.answer:
Yes, it can activate.
This card's [On Play] effect activates <Blitz> if there are 3 or more digivolution cards.

qa.question: I have 9 cards in my trash and a Digimon with this card as a digivolution card is deleted in battle. The deleted cards, including this one, are sent to my trash, and now I have over 10 cards in my trash. Does <Retaliation> in this card's inherited effects activate and delete my opponent's Digimon it battled?
qa.answer: No. You didn't have 10 cards in your trash until after the deletion already took place, so this Digimon's inherited effect could not be active at the time of the deletion.

qa.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include 1 card with the [Bagra Army] trait or a [Yuu Amano], can I still add a card to my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with the [Bagra Army] trait or a [Yuu Amano] is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If both a card with the [Bagra Army] trait and a [Yuu Amano] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?
qa.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.

qa.question: One of my opponent's Digimon attacks, <Draw 1> activates twice from both a [When Attacking] effect and an inherited effect, and their hand increases by 2 cards. Will this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect trash 2 of my opponent's cards in their hand?
qa.answer:
No, you can only trash cards equal to the number of cards added by one effect.
Even if they were triggered at the same time, different effects are still separate from each other, and you can only activate this effect for one of them, so in this case you can count only one of the <Draw 1> and only 1 card in your opponent's hand will be trashed.

qa.question: Does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate after an effect that adds and trashes cards in your opponent's hand so that the result is net 0 total cards gained, like "<Draw 2>. Then, trash 2 cards in your hand"?
qa.answer:
Yes, it activates. This card's effect trashes the number of cards that were drawn.
In the example given in the question, after trashing 2 cards from their hand, your opponent would trash an additional 2 cards, for a total of 4 cards trashed.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect when I would choose and trash digivolution cards by activating the [Opponent's Turn] effect on a BT10-077 [MadLeomon] without digivolution cards?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If you were able to choose and trash this card's digivolution cards after the replacement, the condition for BT10-077 [MadLeomon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect will be met.

qa.question: If my opponent activates BT10-077 [MadLeomon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect when I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to draw 5 cards from the top of my deck, how many cards do I trash from my hand?
qa.answer:
5 cards.
BT10-077 [MadLeomon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect trashes cards equal to the number of cards added.

qa.question: This card was trashed from my hand by one of my effects during my turn. Can I use this card's effect to digivolve one of my Digimon into this card from my trash?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I have 9 cards in my trash when this Digimon is deleted. If this results in my having 10 cards in my trash, does this card’s [On Deletion] effect activate?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: What does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect do, exactly?
qa.answer:
This card's [Opponent’s Turn] effect will replace an effect that would trash digivolution cards.
For example, if you replace a "trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, you trash the bottom digivolution card of this card.
Replacement is possible even when this card doesn't have any digivolution cards.

qa.question: What happens when this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect replaces a "trash all of the digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect?
qa.answer: All of this card's digivolution cards are trashed.

qa.question: What happens when this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect replaces a "trash the top 3 digivolution cards of all of your opponent's Digimon" effect?
qa.answer:
The top 3 digivolution cards of only this card are trashed.
Replacement is still possible if this card has 2 or fewer digivolution cards. In such cases, trash as many as possible.

qa.question: What happens when this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect replaces a "choose 1 digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon and trash it" effect?
qa.answer:
You choose and trash 1 digivolution card of this card.
The player who chooses the card to trash is the player who activated this card's effect.

qa.question: What happens when this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect replaces a "by choosing 5 digivolution cards of this Digimon and trashing them" effect?
qa.answer:
You choose and trash 5 digivolution cards of this card.
If you were able to choose and trash 5 digivolution cards after the replacement, the condition will be met.
You can't meet the "by" condition by performing just some of the actions, therefore the condition won't be met if you trash less than the specified number of cards, such as when you trash 4 cards.

qa.question: If BT8-022 [SnowAgumon]'s [On Play] effect is used to choose a Digimon without digivolution cards, can that effect's trashing be replaced by this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, it can.
Once replaced, you choose and trash 2 digivolution cards of this card.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect when I would choose and trash digivolution cards by activating the [Opponent's Turn] effect on a BT10-077 [MadLeomon] without digivolution cards?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
If you were able to choose and trash this card's digivolution cards after the replacement, the condition for BT10-077 [MadLeomon]'s [Opponent's Turn] effect will be met.

qa.question: I have BT10-085 [Sistermon Ciel]. Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to play a BT6-084 [Sistermon Ciel] or ST12-13 [Sistermon Ciel] that's also treated as [Sistermon Noir]?
qa.answer:
No, it can't be played.
"With the same names" also refers to a card with even just 1 of the same name as any of your Digimon.
This effect can't play cards with the same name as [Sistermon Ciel].

changes.before: When a Digimon with [X Antibody] in its traits would digivolve cards would digivolve into this card, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
changes.after: When a Digimon with [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards would digivolve into this card, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: While my opponent has this card's effect activated, I used [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)]'s effect to reveal all of my opponent's security cards. After choosing and trashing 1 card among them, can the rest be placed in the security stack?
qa.answer:
Yes, the rest are placed in the security stack.
When returning cards that were revealed from a private area such as the deck or security stack by an effect, it isn't considered adding cards to such areas, therefore this card's effect doesn't apply.

qa.question: Which player chooses which of my opponent's security cards is trashed by this card's [When Digivolving][When Attacking] effect?
qa.answer: The player that activated this effect chooses.

qa.question: My security cards were revealed due to the [When Digivolving] effect of this opponent's card, and 1 of them was trashed. Can I treat this as "when a card is removed from your security stack" and activate [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can activate it.
When a revealed card is trashed from the deck or security stack, it is not considered to be trashed from the deck or security stack, but it is considered that a card was removed from the security stack, so [BT4-097 Kari Kamiya]'s effect can be activated.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect to play [BT5-111 Omnimon X Anti-body], [BT10-068 Gankoomon (X Antibody)], and [BT10-086 Omnimon (X Antibody)] from the digivolution cards of my Digimon in the breeding area?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: What does this card's "by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer: When you play a Digimon card with DigiXros requirements, normally you can only DigiXros with Digimon from your hand or battle area. However, this effect also allows you to DigiXros with Digimon cards placed under a Tamer.

qa.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros with cards placed under a Tamer other than this Tamer?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros using the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't.

qa.question: If I play 2 or more Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements at the same time, can I activate this card's effect?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect reads "when you would play 1 Digimon with DigiXros requirements", so if you play 2 or more Digimon cards at the same time, the effect cannot be activated.

qa.question: If I play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements and 1 card without DigiXros requirements at the same time, can I activate this card's effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect can be activated when you would play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements only.

qa.question: What does this card's "by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros" effect do, exactly?
qa.answer: When you play a Digimon card with DigiXros requirements, normally you can only DigiXros with Digimon from your hand or battle area. However, this effect also allows you to DigiXros with Digimon cards placed under a Tamer.

qa.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros with cards placed under a Tamer other than this Tamer?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect also allow me to DigiXros with the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't.

qa.question: If I play 2 or more Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements at the same time, can I activate this card's effect?
qa.answer: No, this card's effect reads "when you would play 1 Digimon with DigiXros requirements", so if you play 2 or more Digimon cards at the same time, the effect cannot be activated.

qa.question: If I play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements and 1 card without DigiXros requirements at the same time, can I activate this card's effect?
qa.answer:
No, you can't.
This card's effect can be activated when you would play 1 Digimon card with DigiXros requirements only.

qa.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect play a [Dorulumon] card from the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
qa.answer: No, it can't.

qa.question: Can this card's [On Play] effect play a [Ballistamon] card from the digivolution cards of a Digimon that digivolved from a Tamer?
qa.answer: No, it can't.

qa.question: What happens to the cards that weren't added to my hand from among the cards revealed by this card’s effects?
qa.answer: You place them at the bottom of your deck in any order.

changes.before: [Your turn] [Once per turn] When you would play a level 4 or higher Digimon card with [Bagra Army] in its traits, by placing up to 3 purple Digimon cards from under your Tamers in the digivolution cards of the Digimon card played, reduce the memory cost of that Digimon by 2 for each card placed.
changes.after: [Your turn] [Once per turn] When you would play 1 level 4 or higher Digimon card with [Bagra Army] in its traits, by placing up to 3 purple Digimon cards from under your Tamers in the digivolution cards of the Digimon card played, reduce the memory cost of that Digimon by 2 for each card placed.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to place up to 3 cards from under multiples of my Tamers in the digivolution cards of the Digimon card to be played?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: When I would play a [Bagra Army] trait card with DigiXros requirements, do I process this card's [Your Turn] effect or the DigiXros of the card to be played first?
qa.answer:
You process this card's [Your Turn] effect first.
After processing the "when you would play" effect, you can then perform the DigiXros.
Once you use this card's [Your Turn] effect to place cards under the card to be played, then you place the cards for the DigiXros under the cards you just placed for the effect.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect when I would play 2 or more level 4 or higher [Bagra Army] trait Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements at the same time?
qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
This card's [Your Turn] effect triggers when you would play 1 level 4 or higher [Bagra Army] trait Digimon card. It doesn't trigger when you would play 2 or more at the same time.

changes.before: [Security] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Xros Heart] in its traits among them to your hand and play 1 [Taiki Kudo] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
changes.after: [Security] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may add 1 Digimon card with [Xros Heart] in its traits among them to your hand and play 1 [Taiki Kudo] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: If [Taiki Kudo] is among the cards revealed by this card's [Security] effect, can it be played?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: If there is no Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait among the three revealed cards, can I still play [Taiki Kudo] from among the revealed cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can play [Taiki Kudo] even if there isn't a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait.

qa.question: This card's [Security] effect reveals 3 cards. If both a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait and a [Taiki Kudo] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only activate the effect that adds the Digimon to my hand and not play [Taiki Kudo], or the other way around?
qa.answer: No, if you perform any of this effect you must perform as much of it as possible, so if both a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait and a [Taiki Kudo] are among the 3 cards revealed, you must perform both "add [...] to your hand" and "play 1 [Taiki Kudo]," or you must choose to perform neither.

changes.before: [Main] Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. Add 2 cards with [Blue Flare] in their traits among them to your hand and you may play 1 [ Christopher Aonuma] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, place this card in your Battle Area.
changes.after: [Main] Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. You may add 2 cards with [Blue Flare] in their traits among them to your hand, and play 1 [Kiriha Aonuma] among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, place this card in your Battle Area.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: If [Kiriha Aonuma] is among the cards revealed by this card's effect, can it be played?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: Can this card's effect add fewer than 2 cards to my hand if it reveals fewer than 2 cards with the [Blue Flare] trait among the 6 revealed cards?
qa.answer: Yes, you can add 1 card if only 1 card is revealed.

qa.question: If there aren't 2 other Digimon cards with the [Blue Flare] trait among the six revealed cards, can I still play [Kiriha Aonuma] from among the revealed cards?
qa.answer: No. For this card's effect you reveal cards, add 2 cards with the [Blue Flare] trait among them to your hand, then play 1 [Kiriha Aonuma] among them. Therefore, if there are 2 or fewer cards with the [Blue Flare] trait including [Kiriha Aonuma] among the revealed cards, you can't play [Kiriha Aonuma] because you would have to add it to your hand.

qa.question: This card's effect reveals 6 cards. If both cards with the [Blue Flare] trait and a [Kiriha Aonuma] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only activate the effect that adds the cards to my hand and not play [Kiriha Aonuma], or the other way around?
qa.answer: No, if you perform any of this effect you must perform as much of it as possible, so if both cards with the [Blue Flare] trait and a [Kiriha Aonuma] are among the 3 cards revealed, you must perform both "add [...] to your hand" and "play 1 [Kiriha Aonuma]," or you must choose to perform neither.

qa.question: Can I place this card in my battle area even if I don't have a [Pulsemon] in my hand?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: I have exactly 3 security cards. Do I activate both this card's "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -12000 DP" effect and "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon face down on top of their security stack" effect?
qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: My opponent checked my security when I had 4 security cards, and this card was flipped over. This card's [Security] effect activates, but is my security stack considered to have 3 cards?
qa.answer:
Yes, it's considered to have 3 cards.
Cards revealed by a security check are not considered part of your security stack.

qa.question: After suspending 1 of my opponent's Digimon with this card's [Main] effect, can I return some other Digimon than the one I suspended to the bottom of their deck?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

changes.before: [Security] You may play 1 black Tamer card from your hand or trash without paying its play cost. Then, add this card to its owner's hand.
changes.after: [Security] You may play 1 [Yuu Amano] from your hand or trash without paying its play cost. Then, add this card to its owner's hand.

errata.notes: Read as the errata when playing.

qa.question: Can I activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" effect when this card is revealed from the deck or when searching/looking at this card in the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" when this card is directly trashed from the deck.

qa.question: I have a [Jesmon GX] that has <Security Attack> in play, while my opponent has a [BT10-042 Venusmon] in play. If I use this card and target my [Jesmon GX], can this card's effect activate [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] effects?
qa.answer: No. Because [Jesmon GX]'s [When Digivolving] and [When Attacking] effects cannot be activated due to your opponent's [BT10-042 Venusmon], even this card can't activate those effects in these circumstances.

qa.question: What does "When you would DigiXros this turn, this Digimon may replace 1 of the DigiXros requirements" mean?
qa.answer:
When you would DigiXros, this effect allows you to replace 1 of the cards in that Digimon's DigiXros requirements.
For example, when you would play a card with [Shoutmon X4] × [Beelzemon] in its DigiXros requirements, you may place this Digimon for the DigiXros instead of [Shoutmon X4] or [Beelzemon].

qa.question: When DigiXrosing, can I place all of the cards listed in the DigiXros requirements in the digivolution cards, then additionally DigiXros this card?
qa.answer: No, you can't. This card can only replace 1 card in the DigiXros requirements when DigiXrosing, not add to the DigiXros requirements.

qa.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Shoutmon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Shoutmon].")
qa.answer: This card's special rule makes it so that it is always treated as if its name was [Shoutmon] as well.

qa.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect reads "You may place 1 card with [Royal Knight] in its traits and a play cost of 13 or less from your hand or trash under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Activate 1 of that card's [When Digivolving] effects as an effect of this Digimon." At what timing does that [When Digivolving] effect activate?
qa.answer:
The effect is activated directly after placing the play cost 13 or lower [Royal Knight] trait card in its digivolution cards.
The placed card's [When Digivolving] effect is resolved as a part of this effect, and once that is done, you may declare an attack with the <Blitz> from this effect.

qa.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack. When does [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect activate?
qa.answer:
Since both the [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] having been played and this Digimon attacking with <Blitz> happened during this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect, the Digimon being played and the attack are treated as having happened at the same time for the purpose of triggering effects.
The turn player can choose the order in which to activate the [On Play] effect and any potential [When Attacking] and such effects.

qa.question: This card's [When Digivolving] effect placed a [BT10-016 Jesmon (X Antibody)] as a digivolution card, then that card's [When Digivolving] effect played a [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc], then I activated <Blitz> in this card's [When Digivolving] effect to attack, and when the [When Attacking] effect deleted one of my opponent's Digimon, my [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was deleted by the [On Deletion] effect of the opponent's Digimon. [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc]'s [On Play] effect hasn't activated yet, so does it activate?
qa.answer:
No, it doesn't activate.
The [On Play] effect from [BT6-082 Sistermon Blanc] was triggered, but it cannot activate because the [Sistermon Blanc] is deleted before it is able to activate.

comprehensive-0117.title: DigiXros Rules
comprehensive-0117.text:
7-2-2-10. An X-card DigiXros is considered to be performed when X cards are placed under the card to be played for the DigiXros. If X cards aren't placed under the card to be played, an X-card DigiXros isn't considered to be performed even if the player declares a DigiXros. (Example: If an effect reads "[On Play] <De-Digivolve 1> 1 of your opponent's Digimon, then if DigiXrosing with 2 cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less," it will be possible to perform the "if DigiXrosing with 2 cards" and later part of the effect only if 2 cards are placed under the card to be played for the DigiXros.)
7-2-2-11. If a card can no longer be played while a DigiXros procedure is being performed, the cards placed under it are trashed.
7-2-2-12. A DigiXros isn't mandatory.
7-2-2-13. Effects that affect playing cards will also affect playing cards for a DigiXros.
7-2-3. The processing for a DigiXros is performed using the following procedure.
7-2-3-1. During the play procedure, the player proceeds up to the step where the card to play is revealed, then if any effects trigger upon play, those effects are to be resolved.
7-2-3-2. A DigiXros is declared immediately before paying the play cost. At the same time, the desired cards to be placed under the card to be played as specified in the DigiXros requirements are chosen from the cards in the hand and/or battle area.

comprehensive-0118.title: DigiXros Rules
comprehensive-0118.text:
7-2-3-3. The chosen cards are placed under the card to be played. The play cost is reduced by the amount shown in the DigiXros requirements for each card placed for the DigiXros. When paying a play cost, the player pays the cost after any increases or reductions.
7-2-3-4. The card is placed on the field and the card playing procedure is resolved.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0228.title: <Digisorption>
comprehensive-0228.text:
16-10. <Digisorption>
16-10-1. <Digisorption> is a keyword effect. When a digivolution into a Digimon card with this effect in the hand would occur, by suspending 1 of your Digimon, the digivolution cost is reduced according to the value specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Digisorption -3>.
16-10-2. <Digisorption> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when a digivolution into a card with this effect in the hand would occur. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-10-3. "By suspending 1 of your Digimon" in <Digisorption> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "the digivolution cost is reduced" will be mandatory.
16-10-4. If 1 Digimon card has multiple instances of <Digisorption>, they overlap when they trigger.37 Multiple instances of <Digisorption> can be activated for a single digivolution.
16-10-5. <Digisorption> can be used to suspend a Digimon that will become a digivolution card.

comprehensive-0229.title: <Reboot>
comprehensive-0229.text:
16-11. <Reboot>
16-11-1. <Reboot> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect is unsuspended during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-2. <Reboot> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-11-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Reboot>, it is only unsuspended once during the opponent's unsuspend phase.
16-11-4. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is mandatory.
16-11-5. The unsuspending from <Reboot> is performed at the same time as the unsuspending of the turn player's Digimon. The unsuspends aren't performed in any particular order.

comprehensive-0230.title: <De-Digivolve>
comprehensive-0230.text:
16-12. <De-Digivolve>
16-12-1. <De-Digivolve> is a keyword effect where the player declares a number from 1 up to the number specified in the effect, then the declared number of cards are trashed from the chosen stack(s) of cards starting with the top card. This is shown on cards using text such as <De- Digivolve 1>.
16-12-2. <De-Digivolve> effects execute processing.
16-12-3. The trashing from <De-Digivolve> is mandatory. Once activated, a player can't choose to trash 0 cards.
16-12-4. <De-Digivolve> can't trash cards from level 3 cards or lower.
16-12-5. If multiple cards are trashed using 1 instance of <De- Digivolve>, all of the cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but the procedure for trashing them is 1 card from the stack at a time.
16-12-6. When using <De-Digivolve> to trash multiple cards, even if the category of the top card changes while the trashing is still being performed, the trashing will continue until the declared number is trashed.
16-12-7. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the processing is performed separately for each instance.
16-12-8. When separate instances of <De-Digivolve> are executed multiple times in a single effect, the state of the chosen card is confirmed after each single process for <De-Digivolve> ends. If an effect will be activated as a result of the confirmed state, it is then activated. (Example: When 3 instances of <De-Digivolve 1> are executed in a single effect, if the chosen card becomes an "unaffected by effects" card as a result of the 1st instance of <De-Digivolve 1>, that card is unaffected by the following instances of <De-Digivolve 1>.

comprehensive-0231.title: <Retaliation>
comprehensive-0231.text:
16-13. <Retaliation>
16-13-1. <Retaliation> is a keyword effect where a battled opponent's Digimon is deleted when a Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle.
16-13-2. <Retaliation> is a trigger-type effect that triggers when just the Digimon with this effect is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger-Type Effects")
16-13-3. The processing from <Retaliation> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0233.title: <Rush>
comprehensive-0233.text:
16-15. <Rush>
16-15-1. <Rush> is a keyword effect where the Digimon with this effect can also attack in the same turn it was played.
16-15-2. <Rush> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0234.title: <Blitz>
comprehensive-0234.text:
16-16. <Blitz>
16-16-1. <Blitz> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect can attack if your opponent has 1 or more memory.
16-16-2. <Blitz> effects execute processing.
16-16-3. <Blitz> has a processing condition that requires the memory to be at 1 or more on your opponent's side. "This Digimon may attack" is optional processing.
16-16-4. After using <Blitz> to make an attack declaration, the attack will proceed even if the memory moves to 0 or more.38
16-16-5. An attack can't be made using <Blitz> if the memory is at 0 or more upon activating <Blitz>.

comprehensive-0235.title: <Delay>
comprehensive-0235.text:
16-17. <Delay>
16-17-1. <Delay> is a keyword effect. While a card with this effect is in the battle area, by trashing that card, the effect specified in <Delay> will activate.
16-17-2. The processing from <Delay> is optional. (For details, refer to 15-7 "Optional Processing Conditions")
16-17-3. <Delay> can't be activated the same turn the card with the effect is placed in the battle area.

comprehensive-0237.title: <Armor Purge>
comprehensive-0237.text:
16-19. <Armor Purge>
16-19-1. <Armor Purge> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with <Armor Purge> would be deleted, by trashing the top card of the Digimon with this effect, this effect prevents the deletion.
16-19-2. <Armor Purge> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-19-3. "By trashing the top card of the Digimon" in <Armor Purge> is an optional processing condition. If the content of that condition is executed, the processing for "prevents the deletion" will be mandatory.

comprehensive-0238.title: <Save>
comprehensive-0238.text:
16-20. <Save>
16-20-1. <Save> is a keyword effect that allows you to place this card under 1 of your Tamers.
16-20-2. <Save> effects execute processing.
16-20-3. The processing from <Save> is optional.

comprehensive-0239.title: <Material Save>
comprehensive-0239.text:
16-21. <Material Save>
16-21-1. <Material Save> is a keyword effect. When a Digimon with this effect is deleted, this effect allows you to place a number of the cards specified in the top card's DigiXros requirements from among the digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers. The number of cards placed is the number specified in this keyword effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Material Save 1>.
16-21-2. <Material Save> is an immediate-type effect that triggers when the Digimon with this effect would be deleted. (For details, refer to 15-8-5 "Immediate-Type Effects")
16-21-3. The processing from <Material Save> is optional. However, if <Material Save> will be processed, the number of cards specified by this effect must be placed under your Tamer whenever possible.
16-21-4. When multiple cards would be placed under 1 Tamer for 1 instance of <Material Save>, the procedure for placing them is 1 card at a time, but they are considered to be placed at the same time. In addition, the placement order is chosen by the player processing <Material Save>.
16-21-5. As long as you use a card specified in the DigiXros requirements, multiple copies of the same card can be placed under the Tamer for <Material Save>. (Example: If a Digimon with <Material Save 2> has [Shoutmon]×[Ballistamon]×[Dorulumon] in its DigiXros requirements, 2 copies of [Shoutmon] can be placed under the Tamer.)
